title: A Way Back Uphill

plate.narration: A griffin leans over the ridge and lowers a rope ladder. Its bottom rung swings above the rising water. Up on the rocks, a dry path winds toward the pass. Time to climb.

goal.text: Find a dry way back uphill toward the mountain pass.

bank.narration: You are on the east bank under Frostfang, close enough to see the broken shelf above. A griffin on a low ridge spots your party. "The path to the pass starts up here," she calls. "Are all of you here? I can lower a ladder."

help.narration: The griffin lowers a rope ladder onto the bank. You can climb straight toward the cairned pass, or first help her move its bottom rung clear of the rising water.

choices.label: Move the ladder to firmer ground

ladder.narration: You shift the bottom rung onto a dry rock. The griffin braces the top until the last friend is off the bank. "Better for the next travelers too," she says.

climb.narration: At the top of the ladder, the path turns toward the Cairnstep. You can reach the griffins without attempting the shelf again. Your rope and packs are still with you.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, funny, curious, with real consequences. Describe actions and sensory details directly. Short dialogue. Never use "the kind of thing that", "the sort of thing that", or "it was X, the type of thing that makes you Y" comparisons. Let a character act instead of explaining how the reader should feel.
voiceGuide.vocabulary: Read aloud to an eight-year-old. Concrete words, short sentences, distinct voices.
